# Generic adapter fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and product-neutral. Agent IDs, paths, prompts,
and values are invented solely to exercise Relayer's generic regular-expression
adapter. They contain no captured user session, credential, hostname, or vendor
transcript.

The cases cover fragmented ANSI input, carriage-return line rewriting,
historical or quoted prompt-shaped text, snapshot replay, repeated occurrences,
and a synthetic credential label.
